cites.stt: Ask HN: How were video games from the 90s so efficient?
cites.x: There are no tricks, you just have to give up mountains of levels of abstraction accumulated over the years. [link]
Casey Muratori's (who has been on here a lot lately) talk nails it [1] - developers just don't realise how fast their code could and should run.
